watch.summary: The streamer calmly counts as he carefully rolls an egg across a precarious obstacle course, only for it to fall and shatter right near the finish.

beats.what: Streamer calmly counts numbers as the egg slowly rolls along the narrow plank.
The egg misses the gap, falls through the structure, and smashes on impact.
Streamer screams 'NO!' and grabs his head in utter devastation.
Streamer stares at the camera in disbelief and says 'That is insane.'

watch.author: creator
watch.why: The calm, rhythmic counting builds tense anticipation that is abruptly shattered when the egg drops. The streamer's immediate, explosive agony creates a classic, highly relatable gaming fail moment.
